scope: Addendum overriding only target naming and comparison-inventory schema in the earlier Evening handoff contract

first_target.label: First target (median arrival)
first_target.meaning: Conditional underlying level used by the existing target scenarios; not observed first option profit or a price percentile forecast

full_target.label: Full target (original Lab)
full_target.meaning: Original Lab target reference, without assuming strict ordering relative to the first target

targets.missing_policy: Canonical price is null and state UNASSESSED_MISSING_OR_INVALID for absent, nonfinite, boolean or nonpositive values
targets.legacy_target_alias: Payload target remains the earlier raw-compatible anticipated_level_q50 value, including historical sentinels; use canonical targets.first_target.price and state for new consumption
targets.scenario_codes: Existing TARGET_IF_REACHED, TARGET_IV_DOWN, TARGET_IV_UP and TARGET_WIDE_EXIT remain unchanged; target_role and scenario_label explicitly bind them to FIRST_TARGET_MEDIAN_ARRIVAL
targets.half_move: HALF_MOVE_IF_REACHED is half the spot-to-first-target move, not half the full target and not observed first profit
targets.full_target_payoff: Not added or inferred by this naming fix
targets.lineage: New saved annotations retain target_naming_parent_source_sha256 and identify ADDITIVE_SAVED_ANNOTATION_NO_REPRICING; prior frozen packets are not edited

inventory.encoding: UTF-8 JSONL compressed with gzip for the saved comparison view
inventory.container: One ticker/session record, available_contracts_both_sides.CALL and PUT
inventory.scope: The complete recorded artifact only; provider_chain_completeness is NOT_ESTABLISHED, not unrestricted chain coverage

source_mapping.option_symbol: symbol; exact supplied OCC, with only a literal O: prefix removed
source_mapping.side: right; explicit call/C and put/P spelling normalization only
source_mapping.updated_ts: quote_timestamp_utc; recorded epoch seconds converted to timezone-aware UTC
source_mapping.missing_expiry: Decoded from a valid exact OCC with field_basis EXACT_OCC_ENCODING; recorded invalid/conflicting expiry is flagged, not silently replaced
source_mapping.dte: As recorded, not recomputed or asserted to be trading sessions

inventory.iv: Finite positive IV is retained. Zero, negative, nonfinite or invalid IV becomes canonical null with a reason; the original value remains in raw_observation
inventory.bid: Zero is preserved as a real no-observed-executable-bid observation, never replaced by a positive bid
inventory.missing_fields: Absent delta, mid, spread and gate evidence remain null with reasons; no bid/ask reconstruction, proxy IV or invented historical gate results
inventory.gate_null: gate_failed null means unknown when gate_evidence_state is NOT_RECORDED_IN_SAVED_SCOPE; it is not ACCEPTED. Future classified sidecars distinguish CLASSIFIED_PASS and CLASSIFIED_REJECTION
inventory.raw_preservation: Every saved input quote is retained exactly under raw_observation; originals and vendor values are not rewritten
inventory.pricing: A two-sided reference quote alone is not a priceable/entry-ready contract; consumers must also inspect IV availability, identity conflicts, dates and missing evidence
inventory.future_writer: contracts.contract_rejection.classify_chain publishes this schema in available_contracts_both_sides; existing legacy contracts_tested and gate results are retained
inventory.saved_adapter: scripts.publish_saved_contract_comparison.publish_saved_inventory; create-only output, source hash receipt, no providers or database writes

remaining_owner: Claude: pricing-basis adoption, prefill propagation and receiving-side target/inventory mapping tests. No Lane B changes were made by Codex.
